meta.parties: Baban Appu v. Gunewardene Et Al

rules.statement: A plaintiff who has a 'right of property' that was never tried or decided against him in an earlier action cannot later assert it as a defense to the same cause of action between the same parties.
rules.supporting_quote: "That clearly is a 'right of property', which would have been a good defence, which therefore ought to have been set up, and which is now conclusively negatived by the decree in the appellant's favour."
